overview_description.description: Cashew is a buy now, pay later platform that allows its customers to shop now and pay later in equal monthly installments. Its platform offers point-of-sale financing with curated credit lines and also provides an option to split payments into installments or simply delay them to up to a fortnight, all without any hidden fees. Cashew provides hassle-free checkout approvals so users can get back to enjoying life's pleasures.
